About these 10 rides

Thursday is the big day: 4 of the 10 ride then. Starts run from 9:30 am to 6:00 pm. After work, 8 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 4 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 3. There are 2 rides made for women, trans and femme riders. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Oct 2, 2026.
